typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	FileDate as timestamp (),
	FileName as string (),
	OverrideReportDate as timestamp (),
	QueryReportDate as timestamp (),
	RecordCount as integer (),
	TrailerRowSQL as string ()
}

source(output(
		TrailerRecord as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @R INT = ? SELECT \'T\' + CONVERT(CHAR(8),@R) + SPACE(130) AS TrailerRecord',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ODW
ODW sink(input(
		DATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DATA = TrailerRecord)) ~> INLTSSFile
